Happy to be bar-raiser on this loop. Quick notes on evaluation rubric I will use:
- Signals for L5: owns architecture for production-critical serving features, quantization+accuracy tradeoff owners, clear past ownership of rollout policy and post-deployment measurement.
- Tradeoff depth: looking for concrete examples (numbers, e.g., latency improvements, cost delta after quantization, rollout rollback criteria).
- System design specifics: KV cache eviction policies, sharding strategy for attention KV, backpressure handling when GPU queue hits capacity.
- Behavioral: mentorship/technical leadership in prior orgs, cross-functional escalation examples.

I agree a 30-min debrief is tight but workable if interviewers use the debrief-template to capture top 3 strengths and 2 risks. I'll do the leveling callout at minute 20.

Vivek
